takeoff_zh: 起飞阶段推力充沛，水平仪捕捉到果断的抬轮俯仰姿态，初始爬升率表现优异。
起飞滑跑加速度均匀，V1决断与V2抬轮衔接教科书般标准，离地姿态稳健。
起飞抬轮柔和顺畅，机头俯仰角平缓建立，客舱过载感极小，爬升体感舒适。
属于典型的高载重滑跑特征，高速达到V1/V2后稳步建立爬升梯度。
短距快速增推起飞特征明显，飞机迅速脱离地面并建立稳定初始爬升。
高原/高功率起飞包线表现出色，离地后保持了良好的速度裕度与爬升推力。
起飞阶段加速迅猛，抬轮瞬间垂直G值响应积极，展现出强劲的气动爬升性能。
离地后采用柔和的小迎角加速爬升策略，兼顾了客舱安静度与巡航加速效率。
cruise_zh: 巡航阶段处于高空平流层平稳气流区，三轴加速度计几乎未测得明显颠簸。
巡航高度与巡航地速保持高度稳定，自动驾驶航迹平直，整体飞行品质极佳。
巡航途中偶遇轻微高空切变气流，加速度计记录到细微G值波动，但整体姿态平稳。
巡航阶段穿越对流活跃区，传感器记录到一定程度的气流颠簸，飞控系统保持了良好阻尼。
中低空区域航线巡航特征明显，高度层保持精准，地速包线平稳。
得益于有利的高空顺风分量，巡航地速表现亮眼，航程推进效率极高。
中远程巡航包线十分扎实，阶梯高度层与巡航马赫数控制得当。
短途干线快线飞行节奏紧凑，爬升与下降衔接一气呵成。
pressure_zh: 机舱增压系统表现出色，巡航期间等效客舱高度维持在极佳舒适区间，耳压感轻微。
气压计曲线完整呈现了标准民航客舱增压循环，爬升减压与下降增压斜率十分平滑。
巡航段机舱内气压保持恒定等压状态，环控增压系统控制精度极高。
下降阶段客舱气压随高度平稳回升，气压变化率控制在舒适阈值以内。
全程机舱气压过渡温和，对乘客耳膜非常友好，体现了现代客机优秀的环控品质。
客舱压差波动极小，机舱气压曲线平滑连贯。
高空巡航期间客舱增压系统稳定维持安全压差，着陆前顺利完成场压平衡。
气压传感器全程记录到清晰完整的增压包线，客舱环境舒适稳定。
landing_zh: 进近与拉平动作细腻，接地瞬间垂直过载极低，堪称奶油落地（Butter Landing）。
五边进近轨迹稳定，以标准Vapp速度精准接地，反推与刹车减速线性柔和。
接地动作干脆扎实（Firm Touchdown），确保了机轮迅速建立地面附着力并高效减速。
着陆滑跑阶段保持了充裕的跑道减速距离，脱离跑道过程平稳顺畅。
接地后制动力度果断高效，在较短滑跑距离内即完成安全减速。
进近阶段水平仪监测到细腻的侧风修正姿态，接地瞬间完美对准跑道中线。
连续下降进近（CDA）衔接柔和拉平，接地速度与姿态控制精准。
五边进近速率控制得当，主轮接地平稳，滑行减速一气呵成。
takeoff_en: Takeoff roll showed strong thrust with crisp rotation pitch on the attitude sensor and an impressive initial climb.
Takeoff acceleration was linear with textbook V1-to-V2 transition and a poised liftoff attitude.
Rotation was gentle and progressive with minimal vertical G-load spike, delivering high passenger comfort.
Characteristic heavy-weight takeoff roll, reaching V1/V2 smoothly before establishing a steady climb gradient.
Brisk takeoff acceleration enabled an early rotation and rapid initial climbout.
Strong high-density-altitude takeoff performance maintained generous speed margins through climbout.
Energetic takeoff roll and positive rotation G-response demonstrated robust climb performance.
Shallow-pitch acceleration climb profile prioritized cabin quietness and rapid en-route speed buildup.
cruise_en: Cruise remained in smooth stratospheric air with negligible G-load variance on the 3-axis accelerometer.
Cruise altitude and ground speed stayed locked in steady trim, reflecting excellent flight stability.
Occasional light shear chop was recorded during cruise, though aircraft attitude remained well-damped.
Noticeable convective turbulence was captured mid-cruise while flight controls maintained safe attitude bounds.
Regional cruise profile held a steady intermediate flight level with consistent ground speed.
Favorable tailwinds boosted ground speed significantly during the cruise segment.
Sustained long-range cruise profile demonstrated disciplined altitude and speed management.
Compact short-haul profile transitioned seamlessly from top-of-climb to descent.
pressure_en: Cabin pressurization performed admirably, maintaining a low equivalent cabin altitude for superior comfort.
Barometer telemetry traced a textbook pressurization cycle with smooth climb and descent pressure gradients.
Isobaric cabin pressure held rock-steady throughout cruise with minimal fluctuation.
Descent re-pressurization followed a controlled rate well within comfortable ear-clearing limits.
Gentle cabin pressure transitions throughout the flight reflected modern environmental control tuning.
Cabin pressure differential remained minimal and smoothly regulated.
High-altitude pressurization cycle completed smoothly with seamless field-elevation equalization before landing.
Continuous barometric logging confirmed a well-regulated and comfortable cabin environment.
landing_en: Final flare and touchdown were remarkably soft with minimal vertical G impact—a true butter landing.
Stabilized final approach led to an on-target Vapp touchdown and smooth, linear rollout braking.
A positive, firm touchdown ensured immediate wheel spin-up and authoritative runway deceleration.
Landing rollout utilized runway length smoothly with gentle deceleration to taxi speed.
Prompt autobrake and reverse-thrust application achieved an efficient short-field deceleration.
Attitude sensors captured precise crosswind correction during flare prior to a centerline touchdown.
Continuous descent approach blended smoothly into the flare for a well-controlled landing.
Approach speed and sink rate remained well-stabilized through main-gear touchdown.
